description: Get the full record of one TriedAgents case by slug (from search_cases or list_top_cases): the original claim and source post, the exact prompt we ran, method, steps, sites touched, result vs. ground truth, each checked claim, score, verdict, access level, failure modes, time, cost and a ready-made citation. Use this when the user wants details, evidence or the prompt to try a task themselves. Cite TriedAgents and link the case page url as returned.

slug.description: Case slug, e.g. 'btc-4h-breakout-check'. A full triedagents.com case URL also works.

name: get_case
title: Get a TriedAgents case
